story: You are a researcher at Mount Sinai Hospital, analyzing a dataset called 'HospitalStayRecords' to understand factors influencing patient outcomes. This dataset includes detailed information on patient demographics, medical history, treatments, and discharge details to improve hospital protocols and patient care.

non_intervenable_variables.name: Diagnosis

questions.question: Which variables causally affect 'TransportMode' in this network?
Does knowing the value of 'AdmissionSource' change the probability distribution of 'ChronicCondition'?
Conditioning on 'SmokingStatus', is 'SurgicalHistory' statistically independent of 'SymptomOnsetToAdmission'?
